name: Stripe parity page: 31/31 scenarios match and S05 shows identical Tera and Stripe invoices
description: FR4. The parity page must report every golden timeline scenario as verified against Stripe test mode and show both sides of the comparison.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page and click 'Stripe parity' in the top navigation bar
Assert the summary reads exactly '31 / 31 scenarios match Stripe to the cent'
Assert the rows for S05, S11, S23 and S27 each show a '✅ Match' badge
Click the row title 'S05 · Upgrade day 17 of 31, prorations on next invoice' to expand it
Assert the expanded table shows Tera total $103.20 and Stripe total $103.20 for the 2027-02-01 invoice, and Stripe lines -$14.03 $38.23 $79.00
